subject: Levels
notes: (kb/Work PB1246) The 77 is never subordinate (nestLevel 1) and nothing is subordinate to it (COBOL2771); the immediate members of a group carry numerically equal level-numbers (8.5.1.3.2), COBOL2771. (kb/Work PB1954) The equal-sibling half governs report group description entries too (13.18.33.1 gives level-numbers 1-49 the same hierarchy in a data description entry and a report group description entry): ScreenReportLevelNumbers asks it once per written entry over each constant-delimited run of the RD (ReportEntryRuns), through the one comparison ScreenImmediateMemberLevel that BindEntries also asks.
